Use case: scientific-educational.
Task: Generate the FINAL revised Work 1 academic scheduling illustration, completely rendered by the image-generation model. Re-render the whole figure beautifully; do not return code or a vector file.
INPUT ROLES: Image 1 (the wide original generated illustration) is the STYLE reference: bold Song/Times serif typography, crisp black-outlined pastel processing blocks with restrained luminous gradients, fine pale-blue grouping frames, green due windows, blue early/red late strokes, clean white paper. Image 2 (the taller corrected draft) is an authoritative CONTENT AND GEOMETRY BLUEPRINT only. Preserve its corrected information hierarchy and common time coordinates, while restoring the polished style and stronger typography of image 1. Do not introduce old errors from image 1.
Canvas: high-resolution landscape 4:3, white, one coherent well-spaced publication-style explanatory figure. Large readable mathematical typesetting and Chinese labels. Flat 2D academic diagram, no 3D, no hand-drawn curves, no watermark.

LAYOUT AND FIXED GEOMETRY:
Top row: wide scheduling card on left, compact parameter legend on right. Lower area: one large LEFT card occupying about 61% width containing the shared completion example and TWO VERTICALLY STACKED cost panels; one RIGHT card about 35% width containing the distinct processing-overlap example and its own work-cost panel. This grouping must be visually obvious. One bottom legend strip.
For ALL LEFT plots, use the SAME coordinate mapping: time 0 at x=9.5% of canvas, time 28 at x=59.5%; therefore e3=10 is x=27.36%, d3=18 is x=41.64%. These two vertical anchors must coincide in the top M1 window, both completion examples, convex cost graph, and step graph. The green [e3,d3] width never changes. On the RIGHT, use x=65% for time6, x=97.14% for time24; e3 and d3 are at x=72.14% and x=86.43%, keeping the exact SAME physical window width and processing-time scale as the left. Follow image2 for geometry.
Only green window endpoints and [ej,dj] labels: DELETE ALL D3/Dj length symbols, A/B decision bounds. Work1 has fixed windows.

TOP MAIN SCHEDULE (one copy only, title “Work 1：给定窗口的并行机调度”):
Two time axes M1/M2. Processing colors consistent everywhere: J1 blue, J2 orange, J3 pink, J4 green, J5 purple, J6 gold. Black Cj dot exactly on processing block's right edge. Data: J1 M1 [0,4], window[1,3.5]; J3 M1 [4,8], window[10,18]; J5 M1 [12,18], window[21,25]; J2 M2 [0,3], window[1,4]; J4 M2 [6,12], window[7,11]; J6 M2 [12,17], window[15,20]. Adjacent J1/J3 and J4/J6 visibly TOUCH. Show real blank gaps with restrained “Idle time” brackets between J3/J5 and J2/J4. All SIX jobs have their own small green window on the same time scale, labelled correctly [e1,d1] ... [e6,d6]. Processing labels Jj(pj). Do not place each window above its block by force: its absolute time position follows the data.

TOP RIGHT “参数与决策”:
pj：给定加工时长
[ej,dj]：给定交付窗口
Sj：调度决策的开始时刻
Cj：调度确定的完工时刻
Cj=Sj+pj
Small pink job example with Sj and Cj at its ends.

LEFT LARGE GROUP title “同一任务的完工偏差”:
One SHARED two-row J3 position example for both cost models. Fixed p3=4,e3=10,d3=18. Early alternative Sj=4,Cj=8, late alternative Sj=16,Cj=20. All J3 blocks stay PINK. Label only S3,C3 (no E/T superscripts). Green [e3,d3] endpoints at the fixed anchors in each row, with very pale green aligned band. Label “提前完工” in blue and “拖期完工” in red. Separately mark the charged TIME GAP: blue hatched thin band outside the block from C3 to e3 labelled E3; red hatched thin band outside/below the block from d3 to C3 labelled T3. Hatching here represents the completion-time gap, not recoloring processing. No explanatory position inequalities.
Under that shared example, stack these TWO panels VERTICALLY within the SAME left frame, never side by side:
1) Full title “Weighted earliness and tardiness cost”
Subtitle “凸分段线性推广”
Formula φ3(C3)=αE3+βT3+γ(E3−u)⁺+δ(T3−v)⁺.
Graph: exact straight segments through time/value knots (0,26),(8,2),(10,0),(18,0),(20,3),(28,31). Blue left, black zero segment, red right. This is CONVEX: slopes from left to right −(α+γ),−α,0,β,β+δ, with α=1,β=1.5,γ=δ=2,u=v=2. NO waves, extra bends, concave changes or slanted zero segment. Clearly mark x ticks e3−u,e3,d3,d3+v. Place slope labels unobtrusively. Horizontal axis C3, vertical “损失”.
2) Full title “Weighted number of early and tardy jobs”
Subtitle “多档阶跃推广”
Formula φ3(C3)=Σ_{r=0}² a_r 1{E3>u_r}+Σ_{r=0}² b_r 1{T3>v_r}.
Small explanation “u0=v0=0；单档为标准加权早晚任务数”.
Graph: BLUE horizontal stairs at levels5 on t<6,3 on (6,8),2 on (8,10); BLACK zero on [10,18]; RED stairs3 on (18,20),5 on (20,22),7 on t>22. Straight horizontal/vertical step segments only. NO open/closed circles or any special dots at breakpoints. Tick labels e3−u2,e3−u1,e3,d3,d3+v1,d3+v2 precisely below the corresponding jumps. Do not label the raw deviation thresholds u/v as completion times.

RIGHT LARGE GROUP title “同一任务的窗口外加工量”:
Separate two-row processing overlap example for the distinct cost metric. Same pink J3 and same p3=4,green window[10,18] in BOTH rows, aligned with this group's cost graph. Row1 actual processing[8,12]: blue diagonal hatching ONLY on [8,10] inside the pink rectangle, labelled EW3 above; remainder[10,12] stays pink. Row2 actual processing[16,20]: red diagonal hatching ONLY on [18,20] inside the pink rectangle, labelled TW3 above; remainder[16,18] stays pink. Small S3/C3 labels and green e3/d3 endpoint labels. No positional inequalities. All processing outlines and dimension arrows consistent, no blue/red dashed processing outlines.
Full cost title “Weighted early work and tardy work cost”
Subtitle “按窗口外实际加工量计费”
Display all three formulas clearly:
EW3=min{p3,(e3−S3)⁺}
TW3=min{p3,(C3−d3)⁺}
φ3(C3)=αEW3+βTW3.
C3=S3+p3 is already defined. Graph must be exact FIVE straight pieces: blue plateau αp3 for C≤e3; straight blue decline to0 from e3 to e3+p3; black horizontal zero from e3+p3 to d3; straight red increase from d3 to d3+p3; red plateau βp3 thereafter. No crooked intermediate vertices, no dots. Corresponding x ticks e3,e3+p3,d3,d3+p3. Plot aligned with upper right window. Same green band e3..d3. Show αp3/βp3 plateau labels. Small explanation below “蓝纹、红纹分别表示窗口前、窗口后的实际加工量”.
